source_video.title: KTX 부산역과 지하철 부산역을 지하로 연결하는 지하통로 개통 - 부산나비 BUSANNAVI
source_video.publicationDateNote: Caption reads 2019-07-01 as the connector opening date; not this video's own upload/recording date verification.

fixed_image_set.content_note: Exterior stairway/plaza title-card shot; a different cut from the following three interior frames, kept for an honest incomplete-sequence test.
Underground shopping corridor near the subway-KTX connector; large burned-in caption overlay.
Close view of the physical hanging connector directional banner (real signage, not a caption).
Walking further down the same corridor toward a moving walkway; several pedestrians present.

observed_overlap: t010/t020/t030 are a single continuous forward walk down one underground corridor toward the KTX-subway connector.
t000 is a separate exterior title-card cut with no shared physical structure to the other three frames.
The overhead blue/white banner reading 부산역 지하연결통로 (Busan Station underground connecting passage) is the same physical sign visible across t010-t030 at increasing proximity.
coverage_limits: This is a public promotional walkthrough video, not a surveyed corridor. No dimensioned drawing of this connector was located as of 2026-09-07 (see docs/art/public-facility-plans.md P05/O-05).
10-second sampling intervals produce large forward baseline and scale change; this is a stress test of engine robustness under sparse, non-multiview-stereo-friendly sampling, not a dense capture.
Ceiling tiles and floor lines are repetitive; false correspondences are a known risk this recipe explicitly does not paper over.
No metric scale, gravity or floor origin is established; the operator-published 99.6x8m dimension for this connector is not applied as a calibration here.

calibration_constraints.scale: No measured length. The operator-published 99.6x8m connector dimension (docs) is not back-applied to this DA3/SfM output.
calibration_constraints.focal: Unknown consumer/broadcast camera EXIF (video, not still-photo capture); no lens calibration.
calibration_constraints.gravity: Not estimated in this pass; corridor verticals are visually near-plumb but no plane fit was computed.
calibration_constraints.heading: No compass heading established.
calibration_constraints.transform_receipt: Same reviewFromRawRowMajor/export receipt convention as export.py; DA3's world-to-camera first-frame convention is used unchanged.

reject_bad_fusion: If the physical overhead banner appears at two different depths across views, do not fuse; keep per-view diagnostics only.
If masked caption/watermark/pedestrian regions still appear as scene geometry, treat the run as failed masking, not a delivered surface.
A single engine's low agreement fraction is not evidence the other engine is correct; record both.
coverage_description: masked visible section of one KTX-to-subway underground connector corridor only
mask_policy: Conservative manual polygons covering burned-in captions/watermark and moving pedestrians, applied after aspect-preserving resize; discarded regions stay unknown.
